item.title: Life360 expands pet tracking with new $8 scannable tags and zoomie alerts
item.description: Life360’s new $7.99 scannable pet tags alert families when a lost pet is found and share its last known location, while new care-tracking features help households keep tabs on feeding, walks, medication, and more.

item.title: How Xbox controllers have changed in the last 25 years
item.description: Every Xbox controller has the familiar ABXY buttons and offset thumbsticks. But Microsoft has slowly evolved the controller over its quarter-century life.

item.title: The pros and cons of managed VPS hosting
item.description: Managed VPS hosting trades hands-on server control for better support. Here's how to decide if the trade-offs are worth it with the higher price tag.

item.title: Meta's apps hoover up triple the data of Apple and Microsoft, new study finds
item.description: A new Surfshark study names Meta the most data-hungry Big Tech firm, collecting triple the data of Apple or Microsoft. Here's what it means for your privacy.

item.title: An analog tube stereo amp for under $800 / £800? From an actually good audiophile brand? Oh, Christmas has come early…
item.description: Fiio's EA13 is a tube amplifier that's surprisingly affordable.

item.title: Polestar claims it was blindsided by sales ban
item.description: Polestar said the Trump administration strung it along for months before finally rejecting its request to continue selling its electric vehicles in the US under a rule outlawing vehicles with connected software from China. In an August 18th letter sent to dealers and obtained by The Verge, Polestar said it doesn't have a clear answer […]

item.title: 'There's zero Lucia content' — GTA 6 fans believe the person responsible for the gameplay leaks has access to a restricted build containing only the prologue
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans are convinced the person behind the ongoing leaks doesn't have access to the full game, but a restricted build.

item.title: New Windows malware lays dormant until a custom command activates it like a sleeper agent
item.description: No one knows who built it and to what end.

item.title: BBC fights Trump’s $10 billion lawsuit over VPN jurisdiction limits
item.description: The BBC has filed a motion to dismiss Donald Trump’s $10 billion defamation lawsuit, arguing that 34 unauthorized Florida streams accessed via VPNs cannot grant a U.S. court jurisdiction over British content.

item.title: Meaco fans sold out completely during the last heatwave — but the company just launched two new tower models, and they're both in stock right now
item.description: There are two sizes to choose from, both with 12 speed settings, eco and night modes, and glow-in-the-dark remote controls.

item.title: Du Maghreb à la Thaïlande, ce forfait 5G garde le voyageur connecté pour seulement 15,99 euros par mois
item.description: RED by SFR propose un forfait pensé pour le voyage. Avec 35 Go de data utilisables dans 137 destinations à travers le monde, voilà de quoi rester connecté bien au-delà de l'Europe.

item.title: Google copie une des meilleures idées d’Apple pour la santé en voiture
item.description: Deux ans qu'Apple soulage ses passagers malades en voiture pendant que les utilisateurs d'Android serrent les dents. Google déploie enfin sa réponse, et elle s'active toute seule.

item.title: Gaming needs a ‘vinyl revival’ — I spoke with gaming and music experts to find out whether physical games could make a comeback
item.description: Physical gaming media could be on the way out, but the music industry has the blueprint for how to bring it back.

item.title: PlayStation Blackout won't matter — and the reasons are as obvious as the physical media you never owned
item.description: Some believe DoesItPlay's PlayStation Blackout week, protesting the end of physical media, is poorly timed and won't make a bit of difference. I tend to agree.

item.title: Quelle console et quels jeux choisir pour un enfant ou un ado ? Le guide pour les parents
item.description: Vous hésitez sur la console ou bien le jeu à offrir à votre progéniture, votre petit-neveu ou vos petits-enfants ? Tout dépend de son âge : toutes les consoles et tous les jeux ne sont pas adaptés et il est important de bien choisir. On vous explique tout, suivez le guide !

item.title: That fake Grand Theft Auto VI demo is actually just malware
item.description: Grand Theft Auto fans, eager for news about one of the most anticipated video games of all time, appear especially vulnerable to this new cyberattack.

item.title: 'The version Microsoft will build should be known as Copilot OS': Windows built around AI may not be happening, but leaked concept remains a grim portent for desktops
item.description: Remember Microsoft's vision of Windows built around AI? That recent leak has been raked over — and fresh details of 'Copilot OS' make me more nervous about the future.

item.title: Vous l’attendiez tous : voici la nouvelle chiffonnette d’Apple beaucoup moins chère (mais toujours trop chère)

item.title: Waymo is expanding to Germany, with service in Munich planned for 2027
item.description: Waymo has set up subsidiaries in several European countries this summer as it prepares to expand.

item.title: Mac mini M6 vs Mac mini M4 : ce qui change entre les deux générations
item.description: Apple vient de renouveler son plus petit ordinateur de bureau avec la puce M6, sa première gravée en 2 nanomètres. Face au Mac mini M4 sorti fin 2024, les différences se concentrent sur le processeur, la partie graphique et le calcul dédié à l'intelligence artificielle.

item.title: Pacific Fusion’s next fusion machine could clear a key hurdle to commercial power
item.description: Fusion startup Pacific Fusion broke ground on a demonstration facility in New Mexico that it says will generate enough energy to power itself.

item.title: Apple M5 Ultra vs M3 Ultra: What's changed?
item.description: Everything you need to know about Apple's powerful new chip.

item.title: Cette fusée française n’a jamais volé, mais son carnet de commandes se remplit déjà
item.description: MaiaSpace, filiale d'ArianeGroup, signe un contrat avec RIDE! pour du covoiturage spatial sur son lanceur Maia, avant même son premier vol prévu fin 2026.

item.title: Nothing lance la bêta de Nothing OS 5.0 sous Android 17, mais 3 smartphones sont exclus
item.description: Nothing lance ce mercredi la bêta ouverte de Nothing OS 5.0, sa surcouche maison bâtie sur Android 17. Refonte visuelle, nouveaux widgets, IA intégrée : le menu est copieux, mais tout le monde n'est pas convié.

item.title: The Supreme Court’s Mail-In Ballot Ruling Is a Step Toward Chaos in the Midterms
item.description: The Supreme Court has removed one roadblock from the Trump administration’s attempts to impose severe restrictions on voting.

item.title: The Apple Watch 12 is rumored to be released next month — get the Apple Watch 11 in stock and on sale for just $299 at Amazon

item.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a phenomenal fighting game hampered by corporate meddling
item.description: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a tremendously fun and rewarding tag fighter, but Sony threatens to be the ghost at the feast.

item.title: Bambu Lab P2S : la marque remet en promotion son imprimante 3D multicolore parfaite pour le grand public
item.description: Dévoilée en octobre dernier, la Bambu Lab P2S est une imprimante 3D aussi bien adaptée au grand public qu'aux professionnels. Actuellement, la marque propose sa version Combo, avec le système AMS 2 Pro offrant l'impression multicolore, à 699 euros au lieu de 749 euros.

item.title: Puce M6, Mac mini, Mac Studio… Le vrai sujet d’Apple, c’est l’IA locale
